title: Checkout Payment Link
description: Web application for generating and processing payment links with support for PIX, credit card, and slip transactions.
fullDescription:
Web application developed to enable payment processing through shareable payment links, supporting PIX, credit card, and slip transactions. It provides a streamlined checkout experience so users can complete payments quickly and securely.

Built with Vue 3, TypeScript, and Vite, the application includes client-specific themes, internationalization, QR code generation for PIX payments, and barcode generation for slips. It connects to backend payment services through APIs to support secure transactions and real-time payment status updates.

The project supports development, release, staging, and production environments, with structured build pipelines and a focus on code quality, testing, and maintainability. A significant part of the work involved modernizing legacy payment flows into an intuitive, responsive interface optimized for mobile devices, using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and code quality.
roleDescription: Worked as a Frontend Engineer and Tech Lead, responsible for leading frontend improvements, coordinating the development workflow, and ensuring code quality and delivery standards.
responsibilities: Coordinated frontend team tasks and deliveries
Refactored payment flows into a more modern, intuitive, and mobile-responsive user interface
Leveraged AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor) to improve productivity and code quality
Developed reusable and scalable UI components
Ensured code quality through reviews and best practices
Implemented CI/CD pipeline for frontend deployment
